His best finish at the [[FIS Nordic World Ski Championships]] was sixth in the 4 × 10 km relay in [[FIS Nordic World Ski Championships 2007|2007]] while his best individual finish was eighth in the 50 km event in [[FIS Nordic World Ski Championships 2003|2003]]. Kattilakoski's best individual finish at the [[Winter Olympics]] was 27th in the 15 km event at [[Vancouver]] in [[2010 Winter Olympics|2010]]. He has a total of four individual victories at various levels all at 10 km from 1998 to 2005.
